properties.description: From the same study: GitHub's server generates its instructions from the enabled toolsets and tells the agent in them to paginate in batches of 5-10 and pass minimal_output, and its result types carry field-selection enums whose comments name the heaviest fields. reflow2 has the same problem and lost to it twice in one session on 2026-07-25 — scan_nodes over 72 Decisions returned 96,000 characters and the harness had to spill it to a file before it could be read at all. The precedent for the shape is already in this design: BL-48/BL-49 gave propagate a bounded summary with the full dump behind full=true. This extends that to the readers that grew unbounded, with the rule that a cap is never silent: the page says how many nodes exist, how many came back, and how to get the rest.
properties.name: A read that would not fit answers with a bounded page and says what it left out
